summary: Phase 1 backend regression and mobile Expo admin testing completed. Existing suite passed 6/6; focused admin CRUD/publish/upload contract passed; public mobile app and all Admin Studio tabs rendered.
action_items: Align frontend environment usage with the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL contract; current deployment exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and the app reads that fallback.
Add testID attributes to Admin Studio tabs and CRUD controls to improve automated coverage.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin Studio loads live metrics asynchronously; immediate post-login rendering briefly showed zero values before the API response arrived, then settled correctly after waiting.
The valid upload response is intentionally 503 because S3 credentials are unavailable; this is expected, not a defect.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_phase1_category, TEST_phase1_wallpaper, TEST Darshan, and TEST festival during the focused test; all were deleted during teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Expected valid upload behavior remains HTTP 503 until S3 credentials are supplied. One initial browser attempt failed only from a duplicate text selector; rerun with the tab-specific occurrence passed.
rca_of_issue: No functional Phase 1 failures reproduced. Environment naming differs from the requested EXPO_BACKEND_URL: frontend/.env contains EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, while frontend API construction uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL fallback.
